Day 0: MAD2 – Project Creation

Go through all the important project-related documents from here.

Important Documents

The key documents you should focus on are:

  • Project Statement – To understand which project you are expected to build for the current term.
  • Project Document – To understand the rules and guidelines applicable for the current term.
  • Milestone Document – To get an idea of how to start and how to structure your project work.

For now, this is sufficient. We will look at other relevant documents once we are done building the application.

Live Sessions

Live sessions will be conducted every Friday starting from 13th February.

If your submission deadline is 10th March, please go through the previous term’s playlist to understand how to approach and build a MAD2 project.

What’s Next?

On Day 1, we will:

  • Discuss the current term project statement
  • Go through the project document and milestone document
  • Address project-related doubts
  • If time permits, discuss which problem statement we will work on during the sessions for this term

P.S.: I will be using the Vehicle Parking App as the reference example for this term’s project sessions.
